source: User-provided IMG_9472.HEIC through IMG_9504.HEIC, plus IMG_9505 2.HEIC; visually reviewed as JPEG copies.

schema.localizedText: {es: string, en: string}; fill segments/answers/words and order items instead use arrays.
schema.fill: activity.segments[lang] contains sentence strings with global zero-based {0}, {1}, ... placeholders. activity.answers[lang] and activity.words[lang] are answer arrays. Duplicate words must be represented by distinct token indices.
schema.order: activity.items[lang] contains the 13 source phrase strips in correct order. Shuffle their indices for the envelope. activity.solution contains indices in correct order.
schema.classify: activity.categories contains stable IDs and bilingual labels. Each activity.items entry has id, text, and category (answer).
schema.match: activity.pairs contains id, left and right; both labels are bilingual. Each pair is a correct association.
schema.examples: Three examples per category. Review is human: the app must not claim to judge spiritual discernment from simple keyword matching. On incorrect review, lose one turn and retry.
schema.move: move.to is numeric or amen. move.condition=complete occurs only on card 9. Other moves follow reading the card. Only one special movement per turn.
schema.visual: paper names approximate original cardstock colors. decorations names identify visible source motifs; stickers offer fallback symbols but are not exact reproductions. photo paths are asset expectations for the integrating app.

resolvedEvidence.detail: The new photograph shows all seven gold paper pieces placed in the blanks: Eve, Tempted, Eve, friendship, Original Sin, Savior, Jesus. It confirms friendship, not relationship. The original spelling and capitalization are retained in the English bank. The former provisional warning is removed and activity.confirmed is true.
resolvedEvidence.displayOrientation: Upright landscape, rotated 270 degrees from the decoded portrait original; do not apply the 90-degree rotation used for the older card photos.

transcriptionChoices.detail: Original contains the duplicated words 'He chose chose'. Display removes that accidental duplicate while preserving meaning and answer disciples.
Original misspells Strength as Strenght. Display uses Strength; associations follow the hand-drawn arrows: Baptism/New Life, Confession/Reconciled, Eucharist/Nourished, Confirmation/Strength.
Preserves the original wording 'Three different figures, one same Light' and triangle labels Father, Son, Holy Spirit without doctrinal rewriting.

Uses all nine visible handwritten examples with punctuation/spelling normalization. This source shows examples already placed in columns; making it a sorting interaction is a digital adaptation, not a new penalty.
Pencil marks appear to be player answers, not printed instructions. They are not prefilled into the new-game activity.

The physical source uses a transparent bag and 13 white paper phrase strips. The interactive envelope is explicitly requested by the user. Spanish uses the corresponding Ave María phrases split into 13 pieces.
Card says HE IS RISEN; the user's later message calls it 'He has risen' and confirms that it is the start. Display preserves the photographed title.
Owner requested the short Ave María / Hail Mary title and child-friendly sequential tap instructions. Original ladder movement is retained as a highlighted action.

confirmedByUser: HE IS RISEN is the start.
Current digital version is single-player. AMEN shows a rotating Vatican-sourced saint popup and does not skip a turn, superseding the tabletop AMEN/angel rescue mechanic.
After AMEN, resume from the numbered card that sent the player there.
Only one special jump or backward move per throw; destination moves do not chain.
Current game title is Padre Nuestro oración / Our Father prayer. Card9 title is Ave María / Hail Mary.
previewChoicesToDisclose: The photos do not establish the physical board arrangement. Layout is a digital reconstruction.
Finishing after passing numbered card 24 is a preview convention; exact original finish and die rules are not shown in the photos.
There is no original automatic validation policy for freeform examples; self-review is used for the solo adaptation.
No penalties have been invented for incorrect fill, order, classify or match activities. Only card 19 explicitly says to skip a turn and retry.
